ranges.description:
A map of {@link WithDependencies.name}s to Semantic Version ranges which can be used as viable dependencies.
```
{
   "platform": "8.1",
   "foundation": "8.1"
}
```

includeBackwardsCompatible.description:
Whether or not to include versions backwards compatible to the requirements in the rest of the
spec.

preResolvedVersions.description: Versions of dependencies that should be chosen during resolution no matter what.

defaultAvailableVersions.description: List of versions available by default.

title: A spec for recursively resolving exact dependency versions for {@link WithDependencies}.
name: DependencyResolutionSpec
